rules.title: Security group must not allow unrestricted ingress on administrative ports
rules.summary: RDP (3389) and SSH (22) must not be exposed to 0.0.0.0/0.
rules.description: Administrative protocols reachable from the public internet are the dominant initial-access vector for data-center infrastructure. Restrict source CIDRs to known management ranges.
rules.remediation: Replace 0.0.0.0/0 with a specific CIDR for the management network.

rules.title: Network segmentation must be explicit
rules.summary: Workloads must declare a network segment; public placement requires justification.
rules.description: Every resource must carry a network segment label so the default-deny NetworkPolicy model can be enforced and audited.
rules.remediation: Set network.segment to private, dmz, or public deliberately.
